name: Gender Roles
overview: Scripture reveals that God created humanity distinctly as male and female in His image, establishing purposeful roles within creation (Genesis 1:27). The woman was made as a suitable helper for the man, indicating complementary design and relationship (Genesis 2:18). Following the fall, the woman’s desire and the man’s rule over her were ordained as part of the consequences of sin (Genesis 3:16). God’s order also includes distinctions in appearance and conduct, as seen in the prohibition against cross-dressing (Deuteronomy 22:5), while recognizing that women can serve in significant roles such as prophetess and judge (Judges 4:4). The example of Martha receiving Jesus into her home (Luke 10:38) further illustrates distinct but valuable roles within God’s design.
